subject: Delegation repositioning & transfer playbook for Novum onsite (late arrivals)
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novum.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Novum Travel Ops <travel@novum.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — three late arrivals (flight delays)

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Quick update — the group of three execs from Novum ran into a mechanical on their inbound (DL 1492). They will now be arriving at SFO at 23:40 local, which pushes our original transfer schedule. Hotel check-in is fine (we'll keep the rooms), but the shuttle service we booked has a hard cutoff at 23:00.

Can Redwood confirm:
- whether an airport meet & greet with a private car is available (we can cover incremental cost)
- if the Redwood delegation can receive a shared transfer manifest so we can hand off pax names and emergency contacts to the driver

Attaching updated passenger manifest and the PAX itinerary pdf.

Attachments: Novum_transfer_manifest_v2.csv, redwood_itinerary_PAX_20261106.pdf

Sarah
Sarah Liu
Senior Ops Manager, Novum Inc
+1 415-555-0123
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novum.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — three late arrivals (flight delays)

Thanks for flagging, Sarah — sorry to hear about the delay. We can handle this without asking you to rebook. Plan we can offer: private sedan meet & greet at SFO, direct to the hotel (approx 25–35 min depending on traffic). We will bill Novum for the difference.

Marissa: can you confirm driver availability and whether we need a second vehicle (3 pax + 3 carry-ons)? If driver cutoff is the issue with the shuttle provider, we should also record the contingency in the transfer manifest and notify front desk to hold late check-in packets.

Lauren: adding you for billing & on-site lead assignment — please confirm the on-site point of contact who will sign for the transfer cost.

I'll prepare an updated shared manifest and one-line playbook for the driver.

- Mateo
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novum.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — three late arrivals (flight delays)

On it — I can get a driver dispatched. Quick notes from ops: 
- We can provide 1x large SUV (seats 3 + luggage) with meet & greet for arrivals up to 00:30. After that we need to split into two cars due to driver shift rules.
- Recommended: confirm pax phone numbers and last 4 of passports for the driver manifest.
- I'll update the manifest and send the driver briefing with a copy to Novum front desk.

Sarah — can you reply with the best cell for each arriving exec? I have the names from your manifest but missing numbers for two. If you can provide the last 4 passport digits that's ideal for airport ID checks.

Attachment: Novum_transfer_manifest_v2.csv (updated 10:22)

Marissa Cole
Travel & Events Lead, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novum.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — three late arrivals (flight delays)

Thanks team — final confirmation: Novum will cover the private sedan for the first car and Redwood will cover the incremental cost if a second car is required (we will invoice Novum after the event).

Karthik — on-site escalation: you're the fallback for arrivals after 00:30. Please be available by phone (I sent your personal mobile to Sarah in a separate note).

Marissa — please send the final driver playbook and the signed manifest to the hotel front desk. I also uploaded the itinerary to the shared folder (link below) and flagged the meeting organizers so session chairs know the expected arrivals.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novum-onsite-2026/itineraries
Doc link (internal billing): https://app.redwood.com/deals/NOVUM-4521

Lauren Bishop
Head, Customer Events — Redwood Inference
